summary: Iteration 6 testing complete for the 4 new features: (1) Install Nudge — appears at ~2.5s on mobile 390px, Add opens install-modal (headless fallback), dismiss X + Add both set localStorage 'hl_nudge_dismissed=1' and hide the nudge; after reload nudge does NOT reappear; on desktop 1440px the nudge is correctly absent. (2) Offline banner — dispatching window 'offline' event (with navigator.onLine=false) shows [data-testid=offline-banner] with 'You're offline — showing saved content'; 'online' event hides it. (3) PWA/SW — /sw.js returns 200 with 'hl-cache-v2', manifest.json + icon-192/512 + favicon all 200; navigator.serviceWorker registration is active at scope '/'. (4) Directions fallback — provider without lat/lng gets href https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=<URL-encoded name,address,island>; provider with coords gets destination=13.19,-59.54. Verified on directory map popup AND on ProviderDetail [data-testid=directions-btn]. Logo legibility verified: header 'Healthcare' span is rgb(15,23,42) in light and rgb(255,255,255) in dark; 'Link' remains rgb(232,157,147) (pink) in both; LogoMark SVG renders in header (8 SVGs) and hero. Backend regression: 9/9 pytest passed (login, providers CRUD address-only + coords, sw.js/manifest/icons, reviews public).
critical_code_review_comments: InstallNudge.jsx: window.innerWidth is only read on mount; if user rotates a tablet across the 768 breakpoint the nudge visibility won't update. Acceptable for a one-time nudge, but consider matchMedia listener if needed.
OfflineBanner.jsx: initial state uses !navigator.onLine — works, but React SSR would trip on window; safe in CRA client-only.
sw.js network-first strategy will cache every same-origin GET (including /api/* JSON). This is intentional per spec but means stale data may be served briefly after reconnecting; acceptable for MVP.
AdminDashboard.jsx still ~650+ lines (flagged in prior iterations) — split into per-tab components when convenient.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ITER6_AddrOnly (Barbados, address only) and TEST_ITER6_Coords (lat 13.19, lng -59.54) via /api/admin/providers to test directions fallback on map + detail page; both deleted after test (verified 200 on DELETE).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App normally has no providers seeded — create your own for map/detail tests and clean up. LocalStorage key for nudge is 'hl_nudge_dismissed' (value '1'). Nudge only appears when innerWidth<768, not dismissed, not installed, after 2.5s. Headless Chromium never fires beforeinstallprompt, so nudge-install-btn and install-app-btn always open install-modal — treat as pass. Offline banner triggers on window 'offline' event with navigator.onLine set false. Provider detail directions-btn is inside an <a> — read href via el.closest('a').href. Directory map view button testid is 'view-map'.
